scope: Close independent P1 comment3967697768: bind both RECOVERY_RESUMED and AUDIT_COMPLETED epoch-audit documents to the active MVP epoch and Work Order. Keep the existing normal-audit event head semantics: its implementation head is not necessarily canonical main. Preserve exact base/main validation, event-order selection and immutable bytes.
required_outputs: Real CLI foreign/missing identity and valid completed-audit tests
Fresh exact machine evidence and independent roles
stop_conditions: Changing non-MVP audit semantics is necessary
Canonical base changed without reviewed refresh
risk_reasons: A foreign epoch audit could authorize the wrong Work Order

design_brief.problem_statement: R4 bound recovery documents but not final AUDIT_COMPLETED documents; validate_epoch does not check the latter's epoch/Work Order identity.
design_brief.current_behavior: Same-base/main foreign final audit may replace a valid current recovery audit and authorize continuation.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Both formats require current epoch, Work Order and base; recovery additionally binds main_sha to its dispatch event head. Correct normal completed audits retain existing behavior.
alternatives_considered: Treat any same-main audit as authority
Force normal event head to equal main and break implementation-head provenance
design_brief.selected_design: Move identity checks outside the recovery-only conditional; keep event-head equality recovery-specific. Add executable before/after tests through the real CLI.
design_brief.why_selected: Addresses the precise reported owner defect without a new scheduler, schema or policy exception.
expected_risks: Rejecting a valid implementation-bound final audit
validation_plan: Old03ec completed-foreign-order case must fail exactly once
Foreign/missing epoch/order identity is rejected on the candidate
Correct final audit continues even when event head differs from main
All lifecycle negatives and full Harness

notes: R4 machine300/22 PASS remains preserved but is not final acceptance after this P1. No old artifacts are rewritten. Process deviation and its removal remain disclosed.
